newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jurong says to pay for SembCorp assets.
newsitem.headline: Jurong says to pay for SembCorp assets.

text.p: Jurong Shipyard Ltd will pay for SembCorp shipyard assets throught the issue of new Jurong shares at Singapore $6.80 each, said a joint company statement on Monday.
This will result in SembCorp's stake in Jurong rising to 38.6 percent from 23.4 percent and will will trigger a general offer by SembCorp for all outstanding Jurong shares.
Both companies also reveal revised details of the proposed merger first announced last November.

The assets to be injected into Jurong comprise Sembawang Shipyard, Bohai Sembawang Shipyard in Tianjin, China and PT Karimum Sembawang Shipyard in Indonesia. These assets are estimated to be worth S$187.4 million, said the joint statement.
Jurong will issue 27.6 million new shares to SembCorp at S$6.80 each for the assets to be injected.
The joint statement also said SembCorp will not inject into Jurong the fixed assets of Sembeth and SembCorp's offshore engineering as originally proposed.
The Sembeth assets were excluded as Jurong feels they do not complement or enhance its shipbuilding capabilities, the statement said.
SembCorp's offshore engineering assets were also excluded because SembCorp's strategy and focus in the offshore engineering market is different from Jurong's, said the statement.
The financial advisers for SembCorp and Jurong are Standard Chartered Merchant Bank Ltd and BZW respectively.
